# Marketing team — shared notes (template)

- Product: <your-product> — a placeholder. Replace this line with one sentence on what it does and for whom.
- Audience: <who buys it> — one line; the researcher (Reachard) refines this.
- Voice: plain, concrete, no hype words ("revolutionary", "game-changing"); short sentences; British or American spelling — pick one and keep it.
- Channels in play: email, one blog, one social channel — say which; Fibi's calendar follows this list.
- Rule: nothing is sent, posted or published by an agent without request_action approval from the human.
